name: eval-cadence
post_title: Diff Review Can't See Your Agent Regress. A Standing Suite Can.
description: Reads an evals.yaml manifest, prices one full run of each eval (cost x trials) against your daily budget, assigns per_change, nightly, pre_release, or harden_then_retire by cost, saturation, and stakes, fails on unowned, flaky, or mis-tiered evals, and emits the GitHub Actions trigger config plus a one-page suite charter
